name: economy_saturation
description: Saturation stops (docs/economy.md §7): an out-of-band market pin (200) clamps to neutral 32 on apply, so the POISON_DAGGER debug buy charges the neutral 8g; and a 5000g grant on top of a 9900g wallet clamps at the 9999 HUD ceiling instead of wrapping int16. Final 9999 - 8 = 9991g with the index pinned at 32.
